info.name: KHR_GEOMETRY_TRIANGLE_MOTION_DEFORMATION
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension. The registry's vertex.position/normal/tangent entries are omitted here because cycles_khr_geometry_triangle.json already declares those parameters (the query generator merges parameter lists by name and would duplicate the 'types' entries); their nested ARRAY1D-of-ARRAY1D elementType is declared there instead. Caveats: Cycles has no time-varying tangents, so a nested vertex.tangent contributes its middle key as the static tangent; deformation keys are ignored while CYCLES_GEOMETRY_SUBDIVISION is active. Keep info.name equal to the official extension name so introspection advertises it.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: time associated with the first and last key array in vertex.position
